chunks: And in the narration of al-Sakuni, he said: Ali, peace be upon him, said:

There is no day that passes over the son of Adam except that the day says to him: “I am a new day, and I am a witness over you. So speak good in me and do good in me, that I may testify for you by it on the Day of Resurrection, for you will never see me again after this.”

key_terms.ابْنِ آدَمَ: the human being, addressed as a descendant of Adam
key_terms.شَهِيدٌ: a witness who testifies regarding one’s deeds
key_terms.يَوْمٌ جَدِيدٌ: a newly arrived day and fresh opportunity for action
key_terms.يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ: the Day of Resurrection and final reckoning

ai.seo_question: What does Imam Ali عليه السلام teach about the value of each passing day?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches that each day is a unique trust and a witness to a person’s words and deeds. It urges the believer to fill every passing day with goodness, remembering that it will testify on the Day of Judgment and never return.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.5849 - In the narration of Al-Sakuni, it is reported that Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (as) said:

"There is no day that passes over the son of Adam except that the day says to him:
'I am a new day, and I am a witness over you. So speak good in me and act righteously in me, for I will testify for you on the Day of Judgment. You will never see me again after this.'"
